name: KO Coliseum BGM - TFT set 15
creator: matthewchasm
description:
A KO Coliseum (TFT set 15) BGM for Summoner's Rift using Updated Theme Music. Very Battle Academia esque vibes.
To use, go to settings > sounds (under in-game tab if on client) > set Summoner's Rift Theme Music to Updated (scroll to bottom).
Featuring music from Riot's TFT Set 15 release 2025. All audio is from the video above.
Thanks Aurecueil for helping.
